texto: Plumy is the toy store system: sales, purchasing and restocking, products, customers and users.
## Log in
1. Type your username (your last name followed by your DNI, for example Gonzalez10200300) and your password.
2. If you want, choose the language: Spanish, English or Korean.
3. Press "Login".
- The first time you log in, the system asks you to change your password.
- After 3 failed attempts the account is locked: ask the administrator to unlock it.
## The main menu
- The menu is on the left. Only the options of your role are enabled.
- Plumy greets you and tells you what is pending. Tap her for another tip.
- Success notices appear at the bottom right of the window and go away on their own.
- On every screen, "Back" takes you to the main menu.
- You can repeat the guided tour from Help → Guided tour.
💡 On any screen you can press F1 or the "?" button at the top right to see the help for that screen.
It opens from User → Change password, from "Recover password" on the login screen, or by itself on your first login.
1. Type your DNI and your current password.
2. Type the new password twice.
3. Press "Save". Then log in again with the new password.
- The password must have at least 8 characters, with uppercase, lowercase and numbers.
- It cannot be the same as the current one.
💡 If the administrator unlocked your account, your password is your DNI again.
It opens from User → Change language.
1. Choose the language: Spanish, English or Korean.
2. Press "Accept".
- Every screen changes right away, and the language is saved for the next time you log in.
It opens from Admin → User management. With "Active" or "All" you choose which users the grid shows.
## Add a user
1. Press "Add".
2. Fill in DNI, first name, last name, email and role.
3. Press "Apply".
- The username is generated automatically: last name followed by the DNI.
- The initial password is the DNI, and the user must change it on the first login.
## Other options
- Modify: choose the user, change the data and press "Apply".
- Disable / Enable: a disabled user cannot log in.
- Unlock: for users locked after 3 failed attempts. The password goes back to the DNI.
💡 "Cancel" leaves everything as it was.
A family groups permissions (patents and other families) so they can be assigned to a role together. It opens from Admin → Family management.
1. Press "New" (or choose a family and press "Modify").
2. Type the name and description.
3. Choose "Patent" or "Family", select an item from the list and press "Add". "Remove" takes it out of the content.
4. Press "Apply".
- "Delete" removes the selected family (it asks for confirmation).
The role defines what each user can do. It opens from Admin → Role management.
1. Press "New" (or choose a role and press "Modify").
2. Type the name and description.
3. Add patents or families with "Add"; "Remove" takes them out.
4. Press "Apply".
- Users with that role only see the menu options their permissions allow.
It records everything done in the system: who, when, in which module and how critical. It opens from Admin → Event log.
1. Use the filters you need: login, dates, module, event, criticality, first name or last name.
2. Press "Apply" to see the matching events.
- "Clear" removes the filters.
- "Print" opens the preview, or saves a PDF if there is no printer.
It opens from Admin → Backup management.
## Make a backup
1. Press "BackUp".
2. Choose the folder to save it in.
## Restore
1. Press "Restore" and choose the .bak file.
2. Confirm. Everything done after that backup is lost, and the system goes back to the login screen.
## Inconsistency detected
If at startup the system detects data changed outside the application, it offers two options:
- Recalculate DV: accepts the current data as valid.
- Restore DB: goes back to a previous backup.
💡 Make a backup before big changes.
It opens from Master → Product management. "Search" and "Active" / "All" filter the grid.
1. Press "Add", or choose a product and press "Modify".
2. Fill in code, name, brand, color, model, price and stock.
3. For purchasing: category, minimum stock and usual supplier.
4. Press "Apply".
- "Deactivate" takes the product off sale; "Reactivate" enables it again.
- If you press "Apply" without changing anything, the system tells you and does not save.
💡 When the stock reaches the minimum, the product shows up for restocking in Purchases.
It opens from Master → Customer management.
1. Fill in the customer data: DNI, first name, last name, phone, email, address, city and postal code.
2. Press "Register customer".
## Export and import (XML)
- Select customers in the grid (or "Select all") and press "Serialize" to save them in an XML file.
- "Deserialize" opens an XML file and shows the customers it contains.
The salesperson builds the customer order. It opens from Sales → Load cart.
1. Press "Select products", search for the product, choose the quantity and press "Add to cart".
2. Repeat with every product. "Remove one unit" or "Remove product" fixes the cart.
3. Type the customer DNI.
4. Press "Link cart and send to checkout". The customer can now go and pay.
- The grid shows the cart total as you add products.
The cashier invoices the carts sent by the salesperson. It opens from Sales → Generate invoice.
1. Choose a cart from "Pending at checkout", or search by the customer DNI.
2. If the customer is not registered, press "Register customer" and enter the data.
3. Check the cart and press "Generate invoice".
4. Press "Charge sale" to go to the payment.
💡 "Refresh" brings the carts that arrived while the screen was open.
1. Choose the payment method: cash, debit, credit or transfer.
2. With a card, fill in number, expiry date, CVV and holder. With a transfer, check "The bank confirmed the payment".
3. Check the amount and press "Charge".
- The invoice is paid and you can print it to hand it over with the order.
The purchasing manager asks suppliers for the products that reached minimum stock. It opens from Purchases → Generate purchase request.
1. The list on the left has the products at minimum stock. Choose them and press "Add to request" (or double click).
2. In the grid on the right assign the supplier of each product (the usual one is proposed) and adjust the quantity.
3. Below you can analyze the available suppliers: line of business, delivery, time, payment method and terms.
4. Choose the priority and press "Finish".
- The request is sent and a PDF for each supplier is saved in Downloads\Plumy - Compras.
## If the supplier is not there
1. Press "Pre-register".
2. Fill in CUIT, company name, contact, phone, email and commercial terms (commercial details are optional).
3. Press "Save". The supplier is available to assign.
💡 The supervisor completes its bank details later.
The supervisor chooses a quote and generates the purchase order. It opens from Purchases → Generate purchase order.
## Register a quote
1. Press "Register quote".
2. Choose the request and the supplier. Only the products requested from that supplier appear.
3. Check the ones it quoted and enter price, packaging and available quantity (the brand is the product one).
4. Fill in delivery time and payment method, and press "Register quote".
## Generate the order
1. Choose a quote from the list. Its products show with the agreed quantities and prices.
2. Check the issue date and the delivery and payment terms.
3. Press "Generate". The order is sent to the supplier as a PDF and "Pay" opens.
- If the supplier has no bank details, press "Register" and enter its CBU (22 digits) and bank with "Apply".
- If the quote is not convenient, press "Discard quote": its products can be requested in another request.
💡 If you closed "Pay" without paying, the order stays in "Unpaid orders".
It opens by itself when the purchase order is generated, or from "Unpaid orders".
1. Enter the supplier invoice: number (the next one after the last is proposed), date, amount and taxes.
2. Check the amount paid (amount plus taxes), the operation date and the receipt number.
3. Press "Pay".
- The amount must match the order total.
- The order is paid and the payment receipt is saved as a PDF to send to the supplier.
The warehouse manager receives the goods of paid orders. It opens from Purchases → Register received products.
1. Choose the order. At the top you see the order total and its invoice data, to compare.
2. For each product enter the quantity received, the condition (good or damaged) and the location in the warehouse.
3. If something does not match (missing or damaged products), write the discrepancy in the comment.
4. Press "Confirm delivery". What arrived in good condition is added to stock.
- Then you can use "Print receipt".
It opens from Reports → Best-selling products.
1. Choose the period: Children's Day, Christmas and Epiphany, full year or custom (from / to).
2. Choose whether to sort by units or by amount, and how many to show (top 10, top 20 or all).
3. Press "Generate report". The table and the chart appear.
- "Print" opens the preview, or saves a PDF if there is no printer.
💡 Only paid sales are counted.

VisitaGuiada.pasoBienvenidaTexto: I am Plumy 🦄 and in one minute I will show you where everything is. Here I greet you and tell you what is pending: tap me for another tip. You can skip the tour whenever you want.
VisitaGuiada.pasoMenuTexto: From here you open every screen. Only the options of your role are enabled; the ones you cannot use look grey.
VisitaGuiada.pasoUsuarioTexto: To change your password or the system language, and to log out when you are done.
VisitaGuiada.pasoAdminTexto: Users, families and roles with their permissions, the event log and the database backups.
VisitaGuiada.pasoMaestroTexto: The base data: products (with their minimum stock and supplier) and customers.
VisitaGuiada.pasoVentaTexto: The salesperson loads the customer cart and the cashier generates the invoice and charges the sale.
VisitaGuiada.pasoComprasTexto: Restocking: purchase request to suppliers, purchase order and payment, and receiving at the warehouse.
VisitaGuiada.pasoReporteTexto: The best-selling products report, by period, with its chart.
VisitaGuiada.pasoAyudaTexto: The manual with the step by step of every screen, on screen or as a PDF. On any screen, F1 or the "?" button take you straight to its help.
VisitaGuiada.pasoFinTexto: If you want to repeat the tour, it is in Help → Guided tour. Have a lovely day! 🌸
